tasks.title: Email about recycling collection change
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Recycling collection change
paragraphs: As you know, our town is planning to change the recycling collection service. Instead of collecting every week, they want to collect every two weeks. Some people think this is a good idea because it will save money and reduce pollution from trucks. Others think it will cause problems because bins will get too full.
I need your help to decide on a few things. First, do you think the change to every two weeks is a good idea? Why or why not?
Also, what should we do with extra recycling that doesn't fit in the bin? Should people take it to a recycling centre, or should the council provide larger bins?
Finally, can you suggest one way to encourage people to recycle less so that bins don't overflow?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say if you agree with the change and explain why.
Choose one option for extra recycling (recycling centre or larger bins) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to help people reduce their recycling.
Ask Mrs. Hill when the change will start.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about recycling changes
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town is changing the recycling collection to every two weeks.
Do you think this change is a good idea?
What can people do to manage their recycling better?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our town website!

tasks.title: Story about recycling collection
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the recycling truck didn't arrive on Friday, I knew something was wrong."
